optional: run-supplied reviewed advisory-to-function map and entry points

applicability: accepted SCA matches; languages with a pinned reachability pack (go, java, csharp, javascript, python) run against the retained database; cpp reads the traced tables; others are recorded as no-pack; never reports unreachable

container_timeout_seconds.description: Wall-clock limit for one CodeQL reachability, per language container (database create + analyze). A TIMEOUT is a coverage gap (ADR-0013).
container_timeout_seconds.scale: Grows with target size; see docs/scale-audit-unreal-engine.md section C.

container_memory_bytes.description: Memory limit for the container (CodeQL reachability, per language).
container_memory_bytes.scale: Grows with target size; see docs/scale-audit-unreal-engine.md section C.

container_cpu_millis.description: CPU quota (1000 = one core) (CodeQL reachability, per language).
container_cpu_millis.scale: Grows with target size; see docs/scale-audit-unreal-engine.md section C.

container_pids.scale: Grows with target size; see docs/scale-audit-unreal-engine.md section C.

container_tmpfs_bytes.description: Size of the in-memory /tmp (CodeQL reachability, per language).
container_tmpfs_bytes.scale: Grows with target size; see docs/scale-audit-unreal-engine.md section C.

container_stdout_limit_bytes.description: Captured stdout; beyond this the log is truncated (CodeQL reachability, per language).
container_stdout_limit_bytes.scale: Grows with target size; see docs/scale-audit-unreal-engine.md section C.

container_stderr_limit_bytes.description: Captured stderr; beyond this the log is truncated (CodeQL reachability, per language).
container_stderr_limit_bytes.scale: Grows with target size; see docs/scale-audit-unreal-engine.md section C.

codeql_threads.description: codeql --threads for database create and analyze; keep at or below container_cpu_millis / 1000.
codeql_threads.scale: Grows with target size; see docs/scale-audit-unreal-engine.md section C.

codeql_ram_bytes.description: codeql --ram (JVM and evaluator budget, passed in MiB); must stay below container_memory_bytes (CodeQL otherwise sizes itself from host memory and is OOM-killed).
codeql_ram_bytes.scale: Grows with target size; see docs/scale-audit-unreal-engine.md section C.

reachability_parallel_languages.description: Languages whose reachability containers run at the same time inside the job (each also holds container_memory_bytes); 1 runs them one after another.
reachability_parallel_languages.scale: Bounded by host memory: parallel x container_memory_bytes must fit.
